comment: How hard each weapon pushes each kind of prop (ZzPropForce). A multiplier on the push dot-props already gives a shot from its damage. Rows are weapon ids, '*' is every other weapon; columns are toy kinds (barrel, ball, crate, tyre...), 'default' is any other kind. A missing row or column is 1.0, 0 leaves a prop alone.
